purpose: Basic uncontested Burn competency, not a training reward or competitive-strength metric
metric: Mean own turns to verified win, conditional on winning; report failed attempts alongside it
contract: Both controllers independently face an inert 60-Mountain opponent; self-defeats, draws and cutoffs are failed attempts. Infrastructure errors remain visible.

baseline.metric: Own turns until verified win, conditional on winning; report nonwins separately
baseline.opponent: 60 Mountains; always keep, never play cards, pass priority; deterministic forced discards
baseline.setup: Harness alternates play/draw independently of seats; evaluated policy retains its mulligan decisions
baseline.seed_scope: Policy sampling only; stock XMage shuffles are not seeded

neural.metric: Own turns until verified win, conditional on winning; report nonwins separately
neural.opponent: 60 Mountains; always keep, never play cards, pass priority; deterministic forced discards
neural.setup: Harness alternates play/draw independently of seats; evaluated policy retains its mulligan decisions
neural.seed_scope: Policy sampling only; stock XMage shuffles are not seeded

validation: 268 repository tests passed; 200 trace summaries audited, passive actions audited, actual starting player verified, model checksum unchanged
limitations: Stock XMage shuffles are not seeded or paired between agents.
Conditional win speed alone excludes failures and must not be used without completion/failure rates.
Burn-specific repeated-state cutoff at the 26th identical visible decision; disable for future decks that can revisit states productively.
No blockers, opposing spells or other interaction; this does not establish general playing strength.
excluded_pilots: .local/xmage/goldfish-baseline-20-702 and goldfish-neural-20-702 (pilot measurements; neural pilot interrupted when scope increased to 100)
